title: Incident link candidate from v0.3 (attribution.v2)
description: Link candidate from v0.3: a possible link between an incident and an executed change (kind change, GOV-13), a proposal the commission rejected (kind rejected_proposal, GOV-38) or a confirmed script run (kind script_run, TRN-7). Only code under attribution-rules.yaml or a person through P2 attribution.create creates it; only a person with governance.attribute decides it; no bot creates, changes or hides it, and no bot context contains it (GOV-46). Records of v0.2 keep attribution (urn:botaru:schema:attribution:1). State follows spec/lifecycles/attribution.md.

kind.description: What the incident is linked to: an executed change, a proposal the commission rejected, or a script run.

proposal.description: The proposal for kind change (executed) and rejected_proposal (rejected by the commission).

rule.description: Under which rule of attribution-rules.yaml the candidate was created; human when created through P2 attribution.create (also from a manager's hint, GOV-39).

created_by.description: system for code, human:<name> for P2 attribution.create.

reminders.description: Reminders once a week, at most 3 (GOV-30).

script_run.description: The script run for kind script_run.

from_hint.description: Created by a person from a farm manager hint (GOV-39); then the person who created it does not decide it when the tenant has a second person with governance.attribute.

self_assessment.description: The only person with governance.attribute decided a candidate it created from a hint, or a script link of its own run (GOV-40, TRN-7).

answerable.description: Seat numbers whose holders answer for a confirmed link (GOV-41); visible only to people.
